evidence_short: Mouse blood-to-brain transport of native APC; EPCR-dependent. No engineered peptide tested.
safety_short: APC/protein C competition; anticoagulant and PAR1-linked cytoprotective signalling.
structural_and_transport_gate: Noncompeting, glycan-aware epitope; soluble EPCR; human stroke luminal access.

evidence_short: Endothelial surface antibody uptake; polarized BBB peptide transcytosis untested.
safety_short: Angiogenesis and vessel repair; species-dependent glycosylated EL2 epitope.
structural_and_transport_gate: Human stroke BBB surface access, safe epitope and intact basolateral cargo recovery.

evidence_short: CAV1-dependent fucoidan nanocarrier transport in a brain-tumour model; not a free peptide.
safety_short: Platelet binding and thromboinflammation; extremely low healthy human brain EC RNA.
structural_and_transport_gate: Patient-stroke endothelial luminal protein and nonperturbing peptide transport.

evidence_short: VEGFR2-associated endosomal redistribution; no ECSCR-bound cargo BBB transport.
safety_short: VEGF/PI3K/eNOS signalling and systemic metabolic effects; low ECD conservation.
structural_and_transport_gate: Native luminal epitope and ECSCR-specific internalization/transport.

evidence_short: Intact chemokines move abluminal-to-luminal; opposite required drug influx.
safety_short: Leukocyte recruitment, inflammation and genotype-dependent erythrocyte sink.
structural_and_transport_gate: Direct blood-to-brain short-peptide transport, not shown.

evidence_short: Angiopep-2: partial LRP1-linked BBB influx. L57: cluster-IV binding and brain tracer uptake.
safety_short: Broad ligand clearance; BBB polarity and peripheral uptake; non-LRP1 routes possible.
structural_and_transport_gate: Independent peptide-score comparator; no claim of clinical validation.
